annotations.text:
These four artboards actually scroll.

Expand one (the arrows on its title bar) and scroll inside it — the animations are real CSS scroll-driven animation, not a mockup of motion. The inversion, the waterfall and the word-by-word reading highlight all run.

Start with "The full journey".

The signature moment.

The page inverts to instrument mode where the systems live, and returns to daylight to talk to a person. Day → night → day.

The HUD in the corner reads --night live, in pure CSS — a counter fed by the registered property.

Trajectory as a distributed trace.

Six spans on a true month axis, Jan 2021 to Mar 2027, taken from your LinkedIn. Nesting is real: the UFSCar research role sits inside the degree, and the master's runs alongside the full-time role at iFood.

Your numbers hang off the iFood span as attributes — team SLO 45.0 → 61.1, infra cost −81%, 3 core platforms — which is where a tracing UI puts them and where LinkedIn puts them.

The dashed tail on the M.Sc. is its projected end (Mar 2027), drawn as a projection.

The build-facing half.

Every technique with its timeline, its animation-range and the exact CSS — written to drop into app/globals.css. Plus the reduced-motion spec, which closes a real gap: there is no prefers-reduced-motion block in the project today.

Phone width, 390×844.

No fake status bar and no fake keyboard — the real ones render on top.

The waterfall restacks: label and state on one line, the span lane below. All hit targets are 44px or larger.
